reviews.title: I saved a couple of bucks just to buy a huge headache...
reviews.comment: Not even a day...I was able to install a game and after that it started making a clicking noise very bad. I restarted my pc but after that the unit was not visible any more to be used again. Don't try to save a couple of bucks with refurbished hardware. Just buy new one or buy a SSD instead.
reviews.author: NESTOR I.
